name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City, UT) Bear Lake Fresh Raspberry Crepe (Seed Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Featuring fresh local Bear Lake raspberries, this crepe is delicious but packed with thousands of tiny, hard, insoluble raspberry seeds that can irritate inflamed bowel mucosa and lodge in strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active flares or stricturing Crohn's. Choose the seed-free Nutella Banana crepe instead.
watchOuts: Hard raspberry seeds are abrasive to inflamed intestinal lining
